# DeviceRef

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs generate` from `schemas/policy/v1.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

A device or group of devices (#38).

Appears at: `/policy/rule_set_scopes/scopes/devices/exclude`, `/policy/rule_set_scopes/scopes/devices/include`, `/policy/scope/devices/exclude`, `/policy/scope/devices/include`, `/rule_sets/rules/scope/devices/exclude`, `/rule_sets/rules/scope/devices/include`.

## Variants

### `device_id`

The device's Palisade ID.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `device_id` | [`Uuid7`](types.md#uuid7) | yes |  |  | 1.0.0 |  |

### `hostname_pattern`

A wildcard on the host name or the fully qualified domain name,
such as `FIN-*`. Case-insensitive.

| `hostname_pattern` | string | yes |  |  | 1.0.0 |  |
